etymology: Compound: the hand (寸) that missed the farming season (辰) — disgraced: to humiliate.
mnemonic: Caught idle at planting time — はずかしめる. 侮辱: the insult, formal charge.

etymology: Compound: a person sweeping forward step by step — creeping in: to invade.
mnemonic: The fence moved a broom-width per night — おかす. 侵入: trespass, accomplished.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 辰 'clamshell' (phonetic シン) + mouth (口) — the mouth's twin shells: lips.
mnemonic: The clam of the face — くちびる. 唇: opens for 音, closes for silence.

etymology: Phono-semantic: woman (女) + 辰 'stirring' (phonetic シン) — new life quickening: pregnancy.
mnemonic: The first stir within — シン. 妊娠: the announcement kanji.

etymology: Compound: tracks (番) examined under the roof (宀) — close scrutiny: to judge, examine.
mnemonic: Reading the footprints in chambers — シン. 審判: umpires and verdicts alike.

etymology: Phono-semantic: heart (忄) + 真 (phonetic シン) — the heart held true and careful: prudence.
mnemonic: Checked twice against the true heart — つつしむ. 慎重: caution with a capital 慎.

etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 辰 'stirring' (phonetic シン) — set in motion: to shake, wave, wield.
mnemonic: The hand that stirs everything awake — ふる. 振り込み and 振られる: transfers, and being shaken off.

etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + the creeping phonetic — water advancing in: to soak, permeate.
mnemonic: The flood claims one floorboard at a time — ひたす. 浸る: baths and nostalgia.

etymology: Phono-semantic: thread (糸) + 申 (phonetic シン) — the broad sash of rank: the gentleman who wears it.
mnemonic: The belt that certifies the manners — シン. 紳士: gentleman, sash included.

etymology: Phono-semantic: plants (艹) + 新 'freshly cut' (phonetic シン) — wood cut for the fire: firewood.
mnemonic: 新's original job: fresh-split logs — たきぎ. 薪ストーブ: the fireplace comeback.

etymology: Phono-semantic: words (言) + 㐱 (phonetic シン) — the doctor's questioning look: to examine.
mnemonic: 'Say ahh' — みる. 診察: the white-coat interview.

etymology: Ideograph: 刀 with a dot marking the cutting edge — the blade itself.
mnemonic: The dot shows exactly where it cuts — は. 刃物: everything with that dot.

etymology: Compound: both arms stretched (the old fathom measure) — reaching for an answer: to ask, search.
mnemonic: Arms out wide, asking everyone — たずねる. 尋ねる: the polite interrogative stride.

etymology: Compound: pleasure (甘) doubled — excessive: extreme, very.
mnemonic: Sweetness past the safe dose — はなはだ. 甚大: damage reports' favorite adjective.

etymology: Compound (simplified from 盡): the brush scraping the empty vessel — used to the last: to exhaust.
mnemonic: Scraped to the final drop — つくす. 力を尽くす: everything, spent.

etymology: Phono-semantic: movement (辶) + 卂 (phonetic ジン) — bolt-fast: swift.
mnemonic: Gone before the sound arrives — ジン. 迅速: same-day everything.

etymology: Compound: chariots (車) drawn up at the mound (阝) — the battle formation: camp, position.
mnemonic: Wagons in fighting order on the hill — ジン. 陣地: the claimed ground.

etymology: Pictograph: the beard on the face (頁) — borrowed for 'must': necessarily.
mnemonic: The beard of obligation — ス. 必須: non-negotiable, bearded.

etymology: Phono-semantic: jar (酉) + 乍 (phonetic サク) — wine gone sharp: vinegar.
mnemonic: The jar's tart second act — す. 酢: sushi's hidden signature.

etymology: Compound: the banner (巾) before the troops — the one it follows: commander.
mnemonic: Where the flag goes, the army goes — スイ. 元帥: the marshal's kanji.

etymology: Phono-semantic: fire (火) + 欠 (phonetic スイ) — breath on the flame: to cook rice.
mnemonic: Blowing the coals under the pot — たく. 炊飯器: this kanji, automated.

etymology: Phono-semantic: eye (目) + 垂 'droop' (phonetic スイ) — lids coming down: sleep.
mnemonic: The eye obeying gravity — スイ. 睡眠: the doctor's word for what you lack.

etymology: Phono-semantic (simplified from 粹): rice (米) polished pure — the essence; Edo's refined cool: いき.
mnemonic: Everything inessential milled away — いき, スイ. 純粋: purity; 粋: purity with style.

etymology: Pictograph: the mourning garment of plaited straw — worn down: to wane.
mnemonic: The coat gone slack on the frame — おとろえる. 衰退: empires and batteries.

etymology: Phono-semantic: movement (辶) + a phonetic — carried through to the end: to accomplish.
mnemonic: The road walked to its very last meter — とげる. 遂に: 'at last', earned.

etymology: Phono-semantic: jar (酉) + 卒 (phonetic スイ) — finished by the jar: drunk; carried away (酔う).
mnemonic: The jar wins the evening — よう. 二日酔い: the jar's revenge.

etymology: Phono-semantic: mound (阝) + a phonetic — going along with: to follow, at one's discretion (随意).
mnemonic: Wherever it leads, you drift after — ズイ. 随分: 'quite' — following the degree.

etymology: Phono-semantic: bone (骨) + a phonetic — the core within the bone: marrow, pith.
mnemonic: The bone's innermost tenant — ズイ. 骨髄: marrow; 真髄: the marrow of an art.

etymology: Phono-semantic: mountain (山) + 宗 (phonetic スウ) — reverence mountain-high: to venerate.
mnemonic: The shrine placed on the summit — スウ. 崇拝: worship, altitude included.

etymology: Phono-semantic: wood (木) + 区 (phonetic スウ) — the door's turning post: pivot, the crucial center.
mnemonic: The small wooden part the whole door obeys — スウ. 中枢: the nerve center.

etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 居 (phonetic キョ→す) — placed to stay: to install.
mnemonic: Set down where it will live — すえる. 据え置き: left right there.

etymology: Phono-semantic: tree (木) + 彡 (phonetic サン→すぎ) — the needle-streaked conifer: cedar.
mnemonic: The tree drawn with falling needles — すぎ. 杉: Japan's pollen antagonist.

etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 登 (phonetic チョウ→す) — sediment settled, water clear: limpid.
mnemonic: Still long enough to see the bottom — すむ. 澄んだ空: the post-rain sky.

etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 頼 (phonetic ライ→せ) — the fast shallow stretch: rapids.
mnemonic: Where the river shows its stones — せ. 瀬戸際: the brink — one shallow from disaster.

etymology: Compound: the field (田) worked in measured ridges — the furrow; the old land unit.
mnemonic: The field's corduroy — うね. 畝: what tractors write.

etymology: Compound ideograph: straight (正) under the sun (日) — plainly right: this, just so.
mnemonic: True in broad daylight — ゼ. 是非: right-and-wrong — 'by all means'.

etymology: Phono-semantic: march (彳) + 正 (phonetic セイ) — the 'righteous' expedition: to conquer.
mnemonic: Marching with justification papers — セイ. 征服: conquest, filed.

etymology: Phono-semantic: ox (牛) + 生 (phonetic セイ) — the live offering: sacrifice.
mnemonic: Life given whole — セイ. 犠牲: the cost column.

etymology: Compound: words (言) sealed by the breaking (折) of an arrow — the oath: to vow.
mnemonic: Snap the arrow, keep the word — ちかう. 誓い: weddings and courtrooms.

etymology: Phono-semantic: words (言) + 青 (phonetic セイ) — the formal request: to petition, contract.
mnemonic: Asked in writing, blue ink — こう. 請求書: the bill that solicits you.

etymology: Phono-semantic: movement (辶) + 折 (phonetic セイ) — gone down the road not returning: to pass away.
mnemonic: The journey with no return ticket — ゆく. 逝去: the obituary verb.

etymology: Pictograph: grain heads at one level — even, uniform.
mnemonic: The field trimmed to one height — セイ. 一斉に: everyone at once.

etymology: Compound: one bird (隹) in the hand (又) — a single one: the counter for ships (and one of a pair).
mnemonic: One bird, one hull — セキ. 一隻: one ship logged.

etymology: Phono-semantic: heart (忄) + 昔 (phonetic セキ) — the heart clinging to what passes: regret, reluctance to lose.
mnemonic: Held one second past goodbye — おしい. 惜しい!: so close!

etymology: Ideograph: the axe (斤) turned against — driven off: to repel.
mnemonic: Shooed away with the axe blunt-side — セキ. 排斥: exclusion, organized.

etymology: Compound ideograph: wood (木) split by the axe (斤) — taken apart: to analyze.
mnemonic: Split along the grain to see inside — セキ. 分析: the lab's kanji.

etymology: Phono-semantic: bamboo records (⺮) + a phonetic — the family and land rolls: register.
mnemonic: Your name in the bamboo files — セキ. 国籍, 戸籍: where the state keeps you.
